input: Find bribery and market-manipulation enforcement actions involving Glencore since 2018

output.assessment: As of 2026-11-10, Glencore has substantial historical bribery and market-manipulation exposure; the entries below identify the actual group entity or former employee involved rather than attributing subsidiary convictions to Glencore plc. The DOJ ended both group monitorships in March 2025, but the latest opened sources still disclose the Jersey investigation, as at 2026-06-30, and pending UK proceedings against former employees, as reported on 2026-09-10. Gross DOJ, CFTC and UK monetary sanctions overlap through credits and should not be added together.
